title: Pug Dweller
description: A lightweight multiplayer-focused project that improves performance, enhances visuals, and adds simple tools for communication and exploration.
body:
This project was originally created for the Pug Dwellers group, but it’s also perfect for anyone who wants a clean and simple setup that improves gameplay without hurting performance.

The goal is to keep things lightweight while still adding features that feel necessary. Instead of overwhelming you with content, it focuses on small but meaningful improvements that make playing smoother, easier, and more enjoyable.

This project will continue to receive updates with simple but important additions that improve gameplay without sacrificing performance.

We hope you enjoy using it as much as our group does.
